L01 Event ground truthOpenNo coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.Source: Phase 1 issue register (CRITICAL); Phase 8 F15

L02 Missing month kiln i septemberOpenKiln-I September 2025 workbook is truncated and unreadable, so the score ends 2025-08-23 and September is not scored. Nothing is imputed.Source: Phase 1 issue register (HIGH)

L03 Kiln iiia april duplicationOpenThe Kiln-IIIA April file repeats May data; April is absent for that dataset.Source: Phase 1 issue register (HIGH)

L04 Frozen windowMasked upstream122 tags are frozen on 2025-05-06 11:50-21:50; masked in Phase 2 and treated as a data-quality window downstream.Source: Phase 1 issue register; Phase 2 masks

L05 Sentinel valuesMasked upstreamSentinel 99999 in 35 columns, -273 degC and text 'Error 6' are masked, not repaired.Source: Phase 1 issue register; Phase 2 masks

L06 Unit review holdsOpen13 columns are held pending plant unit confirmation and are excluded from the score.Source: phase-02-baseline/outputs/column_holds.csv

L07 O2 analyser kiln i xOpenFrequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.Source: Phase 7 report; Phase 8 F5, F17

L08 Load dependenceOpenThe score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.Source: Phase 7 report; Phase 8 F6

L09 Operating state proxyOpenRUNNING / STOPPED is a POC proxy from Kiln MD and feed; the meaning of Kiln MD and the equipment identity are unconfirmed.Source: Phase 2

L10 Reference dependenceOpenBand levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.Source: Phase 6 robustness; Phase 7 robustness

L11 Censored onsetsOpen6 of the 12 abnormal-period onsets are censored by the look-back cap; the small positive pre-onset estimate comes from them.Source: Phase 8 F18

L12 TimezoneOpenThe historian export carries no timezone. The API serves naive timestamps unchanged and requires plant annotations to use the same naive plant-local clock.Source: Phase 1 plant question 7

L13 High band not rareFor informationThe HIGH reference-relative band covers about half of August operational buckets; it is not a rare-event flag and not an alarm level.Source: Phase 7 report

DALMIA CEMENT|Kiln Analytical POC

Ariyalur kiln · Jun–Aug 2025 · historical

Retrospective, not an early warning. Historical analysis of Jun–Aug 2025 only. It does not show live data, raise alarms or detect deposits, rings or coating.

Retrospective, not an early warning. Historical analysis of Jun–Aug 2025 only. It does not show live data, raise alarms or detect deposits, rings or coating.

Read-only hosted copy. It shows exported analysis results and cannot save plant annotations.

timezone-naive historian export (no timezone supplied; plant question open). Scores are 10-min buckets labelled by bucket end: a row at T covers (T - 10 min, T]. Timestamps are served exactly as stored, never converted, resampled or filled.

Artifact integrity

Each file the API serves is hash-checked at start-up. If any differs, the API refuses to answer: The analysis service refused to serve results because a stored file failed its integrity check. Nothing is shown rather than unverified numbers. See /ready on the service.

What the evidence shows

How to read this

The O₂ analyser may be reading ambient airFrequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.Source: L07

The O₂ analyser may be reading ambient air

Frequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.

Times have no timezoneThe historian export carries no timezone. The API serves naive timestamps unchanged and requires plant annotations to use the same naive plant-local clock.Source: L12

Times have no timezone

The historian export carries no timezone. The API serves naive timestamps unchanged and requires plant annotations to use the same naive plant-local clock.

The score is reference-relativeBand levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.Source: L10

The score is reference-relative
